assets.prompt: Asset type: one 2 by 2 game HUD avatar atlas containing four distinct original fictional island civilization leaders, for a premium Catan strategy tabletop game. Composition: square 1024x1024 canvas, exactly four equal cells in a strict 2x2 grid. In each cell place a centered painted head and upper shoulders portrait fully inside a circular silhouette with generous transparent margin: top-left a confident young dark-haired male navigator wearing warm rust red coat; top-right a dignified older female trader in orange and tan clothes; bottom-left a calm bearded male scholar in pale cream and blue; bottom-right a sharp-eyed female knight with blue mantle and silver armor. Tasteful painterly 3D strategy-game illustration, clear distinctive face silhouettes visible at 48px, warm gold studio light, consistent view straight ahead slightly turned. No real people, no existing game characters, no logos, no words, no ornate frame (frame drawn separately by UI). Actual transparent background in every cell outside portrait. Keep cell boundaries clean so the runtime can select each quadrant with UV cropping; portrait circles must not touch cell edges.
